thread:
maria: Heads up — after the 06:15 deploy a subset of GPU jobs failed with KMS decrypt errors when scheduled onto node-group `gpu-spot-1`. Not all jobs, maybe 12/200. Anyone seeing similar?
ajay: I saw CI jobs hit 403 from KMS too, thought it was transient. Which SA is used to schedule those pods?
maria: deploy pipeline uses `deploy-runner-sa` to create the Job that runs on GPU nodes. Extract from node logs:
```
E 06:16:21 kms: decrypt failed: permission denied for key projects/rdw-prod/locations/global/keyRings/primary/cryptoKeys/gpu-wrap: iam.serviceAccounts.deploy-runner-sa@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com lacks kms.cryptoKeys.decrypt
```
kate: hmm, deploy-runner-sa shouldn't have decrypt. How did it ever succeed before? Did the node bootstrap impersonation change?
leo: I checked audit logs — there are entries showing `system:node:gpu-spot-1` impersonating deploy-runner-sa during pod admission, then KMS attempted with the service account identity. Looks like the node-level binding grants wider perms.
sec-bot: ALERT: found ClusterRoleBinding `cluster-admin-legacy` bound to group `ci-runners` — created 2021-11-03. Recommend review. :warning:
ajay: That binding would explain it — pipeline got cluster-wide perms historically. We recently tightened some roles but not that binding.
maria: So root cause = pipeline SA implicitly getting KMS decrypt via a legacy cluster binding that landed in certain node pools due to node-level impersonation?
kate: Also worth checking the node bootstrap script, we added `--impersonate-serviceaccount` for specific nodepool workloads last quarter. Could be interacting badly.
leo: Quick mitigation: remove cluster-admin-legacy binding from `ci-runners` and create a narrow RoleBinding for `deploy-runner-sa` scoped to the `gpu-jobs` namespace with only `kms.keys.decrypt` via workload-identity mapping. But we need a rollback-safe plan.
ajay: For immediate relief, I can patch the nodepool admission webhook to stop impersonating SA for jobs matching label `test-run=true`. That will prevent deploy-runner-sa from being used on gpu-spot-1.
maria: Can we also add an audit filter to watch any KMS decrypts by `deploy-runner-sa`? Want to confirm no other paths.
sec-bot: INFO: created alert rule `kms-decrypt-by-deploy-runner-sa` (severity: medium).
kate: Longer-term: propose least-privilege refactor: create a `node-gpu-kms-decryptor` Role that grants `kms.cryptoKeys.decrypt` on the specific key resource and bind it only to the service account used by the GPU-sidecar controller. Update docs + runbook.
leo: I'll open a PR to remove the legacy ClusterRoleBinding and add the narrow RoleBinding. Also draft a rollback that rebinds original binding if jobs fail >10% in 30m.
maria: SGTM. ajay, can you do the webhook patch and add the audit filter?
ajay: On it. Will post PR + Helm diff in #eng-platform. ETA 2h.
maria: thanks — file an incident runbook entry and tag customer-impact if we see >5% job failure.
opsbot: incident created: INC-2026-441-gpu-kms-rbac. Assigned: kate, ajay, leo, maria.
kate: Also flagging security review for KMS key policy. We might want key rotation after we close the access hole.
maria: agreed. will schedule 1:1 with sec to walk through. :thumbsup:
